app.name: Music Assistant
app.summary: What plays in your rooms, with covers, straight from Music Assistant.
app.ma_host_hint: Its IP address on your network, such as 192.168.1.20 (port 8095).
app.ma_token_hint: The first 200 characters of a long-lived token from Music Assistant (Settings, Profile). Tessera takes at most 256 per field.
app.player_hint: Part of the player's name in Music Assistant, such as Bath. Empty: whatever plays.
app.title: Track title
app.title_hint: How large the title is, or hide it.
